subject: sleep log not used in part 4

messages.author: ceeb8be64737dda0
messages.subject: sleep log not used in part 4
parts:
Hello!
We are trying to use GGIR on some GTX3 data. We have two nights of recording (night only), and lightoff/on time stamp for the two nights. 
I specified sleeplog location with the following code:

loglocation="Raw/GGIR_trial/sleeplog.csv", 
  sleeplogidnum=FALSE,
  nnights=2,
  def.noc.sleep=1,
  colid=1,
  coln1=2,
relyonguider=TRUE,
  sleeplogsep=",",  
  sleepwindowType ="TimeInBed",
  HASIB.algo = "ColeKripke1992",
  Sadeh_axis = "Y",
  ignorenonwear=TRUE,
  
And I received an error message:  Report part 4
 loading all the milestone data from part 4 this can take a few minutes
[1] "report not stored, because no results available"

And when I checked part4_nightsummary_sleep_full.csv, the sleeplog was not used (guider=HDCZA).
I read some of the previous posts in this group, and made sure that the sleeplog ID matched the part2_summary.csv file. 
I have the sleep log, and part4_nightsummary files attached here. 
Please help, or let me know what I have done wrong. 
Thank you!

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: sleep log not used in part 4
parts:
Hi Eva,

The reason why you get the "no results available" error in part 4 is that none of your nights meet the "includenightcrit", which is by default 16 valid hours from 12pm to 12pm the next day. Given that your recording starts at 20:30, it is impossible that the first night meets this requirement. In fact, I see in your part2_summary report that none of the recorded days have enough valid time (N.valid.Wkdays = 0, N.valid.WEdays = 0). Do you expect a lot of nonwear time in your recording for any reason? Try to set includedaycrit and includenightcrit to a lower number to see if you get these days included in the sleep analysis.

Regarding the sleeplog, I'm not sure why it is not being matched, can you try to read your sleeplog with the function g.loadlog?

x = GGIR::g.loadlog("Raw/GGIR_trial/sleeplog.csv", coln1 = 2, colid = 1, nnights = 2, desiredtz = "")

Best,
Jairo
